description: The year-free names given in the 2025 tree to every id that carried a year (the owner's decision; the coordinator
chose the names). One entry per old id: the new id, the class of the year it
carried (tools/year_ids.json, 'classes', plus fixed_date: a date in the law that does not move with the tax year)
and why the name says what the line is. A review tool carries each verdict from the old id to the new one by this map.
Dotted ids under the document clcw26 are renamed by the document entry (clcw26.<x> to clcw_next_year.<x>).

clcw26.why: the capital loss carryover worksheet figured for next year's return

asset.is2025.why: placed in service in the tax year

asset.on_26_2025.why: listed property placed this year, reported on lines 25 and 26

asset.macrs2025.why: MACRS on property placed this year; pairs with asset.macrs_prior

asset.mq_q4_2025.why: the mid-quarter basis (asset.mqbase) when placed in October to December; the line itself does not test the year

asset.dep_2025.why: MACRS on property placed this year; pairs with asset.dep_prior

asset.bonus_2025.why: special allowance on property placed this year

asset.s179_2025.why: section 179 elected on property placed this year

asset.cost179_2025.why: the business cost when used more than 50% in the business; the line itself does not test the year (asset.cost179 does)

asset.ended_2025.why: disposed of, in part or whole, or converted to personal use in the tax year

asset.before_2017.why: acquired before September 28, 2017, the first acquisition date of the special allowance of i4562 line 14 (a date in the law; it does not move)

scveh.is2025.why: vehicle placed in service in the tax year

scveh.is2019.why: the tax year is the first after the vehicle's recovery period (recovery year 7, Pub. 946 p. 61)

scveh.claims_bonus_2025.why: placed this year and a special allowance is claimed

scveh.before_2017_if_2025.why: the gate of scveh.acquired_before_bonus_date: asked only of a vehicle placed this year

scveh.lim_2025.why: the depreciation limit of a vehicle placed this year; pairs with scveh.lim_prior

scveh.s179_2025_ok.why: section 179 elected for a vehicle placed this year

scveh.line10_2025.why: line 10 for a vehicle placed this year

scveh.bonus_2025.why: special allowance for a vehicle placed this year

scveh.line19_2025.why: line 19 for a vehicle placed this year; pairs with scveh.line19_earlier

scveh.s179_2025.why: column (i), section 179 cost of a vehicle placed this year

scveh.s179_2025_o.why: the same, owned and on actual expenses

dependent.edu_a2025.why: tax-free educational assistance received this year (worksheet line 2a)

dependent.edu_a2026.why: tax-free educational assistance received next year before filing (worksheet line 2b)

person.edu_a2025.why: as dependent.edu_a_this_year, for the filer or spouse

person.edu_a2026.why: as dependent.edu_a_next_year, for the filer or spouse

eic.died_2025.why: the spouse died this year, or the return is for someone who died this year

f2441.paid_2026.why: care expenses incurred this year not already counted in the per-person amounts; the old year was not what the line is about

f8880.dist_2025.why: the distributions of this year's return that line 4 counts

f8962.married_in_2025.why: married during the tax year with coverage before the first full month of marriage

household.spouse_died_2025.why: the spouse died in the tax year

household.widowed_2025.why: filing single or head of household although the spouse died this year

refund.not_2024.why: a refund for a year other than the prior year, or prior-year tax paid outside the usual time

refund.line5d_2024.why: line 5d of the prior year's Schedule A

refund.line5e_2024.why: line 5e of the prior year's Schedule A

refund.line17_2024.why: line 17 of the prior year's Schedule A

person.born_after_1960.why: under 65 at year end by the earned income credit's own birth-date test (born after December 31 of the year 65 years before)

person.born_before_2001.why: 25 or older at year end by the earned income credit's birth-date test

person.edu_born_2002.why: 24 or older at year end (not 'under age 24', i8863 line 7)

person.edu_born_2007.why: over age 18 at year end (i8863 line 7)

person.born_2010.why: born in the one year in which the birth year leaves 'under 16 at year end' open

person.born_1976.why: born in the one year in which the birth year leaves '50 or older at year end' open

person.born_1971.why: born in the one year in which the birth year leaves '55 or older at year end' open

person.simple_age_1976.why: the catch-up band of a person born in the age-50 open year, from that person's age-50 answer

person.turned_65_in_2025.why: the 65th birthday, or the day before it, fell in the tax year

retirement.born_1936.why: the plan participant was born before January 2, 1936, the date of birth that opens Form 4972 (a date in the law; it does not move)

retirement.start_1996.why: annuity payments started before November 19, 1996, after which the Simplified Method is required (a date in the law; it does not move)

f8853c.pre1996.why: a contract issued before August 1, 1996, the date from which long-term care contracts are qualified (a date in the law; it does not move)

rec.not_2024.why: money paid back for something paid or deducted before the prior year

rental.has_2025.why: Form 4562 is needed for the property (something placed in service this year); the line is about the form, not the year

rprop.is_2025.why: one cent if placed in service in the tax year, zero otherwise (a count term)

rprop.placed_2025.why: placed in service in the tax year

s1.nol_pre2018.why: a loss from a tax year that began before 2018, before the 80% limit on the deduction (a date in the law; it does not move)
